evidence: Modifies descriptor warning logic in src/script/descriptor.cpp and functional coverage in test/functional/wallet_importdescriptors.py.
rationale: Warns when multipath descriptor expansion silently duplicates single-path keys across branches, mitigating potential address clustering and key reuse across receive and change chains (issue #35985). While helpful for wallet privacy and key management, it addresses a specific descriptor construction and is reasonably deferrable.
